Qty Add to Cart Description Mid-Fi Electronics Random Number Generator Pedal Step into a world of unpredictable fuzz! The Mid-Fi Electronics Random Number Generator isnt your average distortion pedalit adds wild, harmonically rich arpeggiation that shifts and evolves as you play. If you love chaos, texture, and unique tones, this pedal will take your sound to places you never expected. Mid-Fi Electronics Random Number Generator Pedal Review Beneath its simple design lies a truly experimental fuzz box. The Random Number Generator creates thick, glitchy fuzz with a built-in random low-frequency arpeggiation effect. This means your notes morph and shift in pitch, creating unpredictable, harmonically related patterns that give your sound a swirling, otherworldly feel. Its a dream for adventurous players looking for fresh inspiration. Mid-Fi Electronics Random Number Generator Pedal Features Creates random, shifting arpeggios for unpredictable soundscapes Thick, textured fuzz with plenty of character Simple volume control keeps things easy to dial in Perfect for experimental, psychedelic, and noise-driven music True bypass for clean signal when switched off Mid-Fi Electronics Random Number Generator Pedal Specs Unique low-frequency arpeggiation effect Compact and pedalboard-friendly design Operates on 9V DC power (negative tip) True bypass switching What’s in the box of our Mid-Fi Electronics Random Number Generator Pedal?
